execution_contract.guest_clock_mapping: guest sample plus remaining original host UTC/monotonic phase budget after reply; host deadlines are not renewed
execution_contract.journal: one attempt per store, durable intent before I/O; possible-send retained until bound result and original stop ledger plus independent poweroff receipt
execution_contract.source_binding: grant equals process-start epoch and current files; rechecked before dispatch; caller payload bytes frozen; identity/helper source extracted from verified entry bytes

limits: No actual root staging, selected-VM transfer, service command, root apply or VM action ran. POSIX checks use UID 1000 temporary paths and synthetic commands/callbacks; they do not qualify target-root behavior.

Review packets contain empty actual identity/backup/approval/original-lease fields. Controls contain no fabricated observation. They refuse before native dispatch and are not deployable host packages.

Native live-state collection, original-owner liveness/signalling, peer identity, approval authentication and independent stop/storage observations are unimplemented or unqualified boundaries. A blocked sampler may outlive bounded close, so a qualified collector remains necessary.

Controls require an approved genuine current-boot inspection. Completed inspection attempts stop their VM; the stopped boot-bound observation cannot authorize another boot. Same-boot acquisition and approval handoff remain unresolved.

Synthetic role/purpose compilations fit native transport limits. Static review layouts omit real observations, capsule and helper; compression/layout data alone do not prove native command delivery or fit for a future real observation.
Guest clock mapping does not qualify clock drift, pause or suspend. Original outside-VM wall/monotonic lease, revocation and independent stop remain authoritative.

Directory and namespace checks do not protect against hostile guest root or bind-mount manipulation. Root-only staging, service quiescence, kernel stalls, physical-power/database-loss recovery and native stop/reap remain unqualified.
Hashes and receipt consistency checks do not authenticate approvals or prove callback observations are true. Frozen historical media/VDI/package evidence was not refreshed.
Earlier source snapshots and test attempts remain intact. Only final native-03, regression-02 and role/purpose revision-02 packets bind the final source cohort.
Package/media verification, installation, repeated readiness, final isolation/routing/recovery and the product feasibility decision remain open.
next_check: Prepare and qualify bounded live-state/original-supervisor stop adapters and the same-boot inspection/approval handoff. Pending guard creation and phase-boundary choices remain separate; do not activate a VM or transfer/control packet without its applicable approvals.
